headSubject: fix(gate): runtimeHost gate fails when its security-consistency report fails, and produces the evidence that report needs
summary: Owner-away stretch. Landed: npdev db detect (RUN-37 CLI half, 18 tests, listener path verified on a real socket); open-state/prep agree on what is closed (WONTFIX); REG-26 flipped to WONTFIX (guard exemption 168->167); mob2 golden routine fixed (waited on a nav the page disables) -> golden browser 6/6; run-f6-showcase now records its cadence pass; run_digest names a missing command; a11y baseline stops rewriting unchanged entries; runtimeHost gate now produces the security-maturity evidence and FAILS when its security-consistency report fails (it used to pass while that report said failed). T1 tier: no blocking overdue. All four T2 gates green this session (generator 134s, runtimeHost 443s, kernel 31s cached, aiKnowledge 1006s). New repo https://github.com/MarceloGiazzon/ProcessTrackerForAI (public, placeholder README); idea doc in OutsideRepo/process-tracker-for-ai-idea-2026-10-27.md. Manager 0.5.2 + Find databases button rebuilt but UNCOMMITTED.
nextStep: 1) Owner: close the running Manager, launch D:\WorkSpace\NPDev\Build\manager-target\release\npdev-manager.exe (now includes Find databases; old copy is npdev-manager.old-running.exe, delete it), Install tab: Use local repo, Step 4 ready with 53 jars, then Doctor/Engines, then New app > Find databases (needs a running DB container or a default-port listener to see Use this). 2) If good, run scripts/hygiene/clean-workspace-state.ps1 and commit NPDevManager/* plus ledger/items/RUN-37.yml as Manager 0.5.2 + RUN-37 Manager half. 3) AIP-4 4.5 real-window walk, screenshots to OutsideRepo/evidence/aip-4-manager-2026-10-27/. 4) betaRelease needs a full beta evidence run (31 of 35 reports missing here; Docker parity disabled by local profile) -- an owner decision.
verified: T2 gates green individually (see summary); T1 cadence clean; cargo test 54/54; golden browser 6/6; db detect tests 18/18 plus mutation-checked. NOT verified: Manager in a real window; db detect against a real Docker container (daemon off); the new runtimeHost enforcement red path (a genuinely failing security check).
